change: The man is crouched at a toilet scrubbing hard at one spot inside the bowl with a brush, shoulder working, his face set with effort and a little frustration. The water in the bowl is cloudy. Small bathroom, tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he scrubs the same spot three more times and then stops and looks at it

change: Wide view of an open white toilet with a dry empty bowl, a patch of white foam sitting on one side of the porcelain at the old waterline and the rest of the bowl completely still and clean. Small bathroom, white tile, daylight from a window on the left.
motion: the patch of foam creeps slightly wider on that one side and nothing happens anywhere else
causality: foam appears only where it already is and never on the clean part of the bowl

change: The man is crouched beside a toilet with one forearm on the rim, lifting his head away from the bowl to look toward the camera, mid thought, eyebrows slightly raised. Small bathroom, white tile, daylight from the left.
motion: he lifts his head the rest of the way up from the bowl and holds the look

change: Close view of the man turning a small brown glass bottle in his fingers to look at a faded, curling white label on the back of it, his eyes narrowed. Bathroom counter below, daylight from the left, no text
motion: he rotates the bottle further so more of the faded label comes around into view

change: The man is standing over a small plastic bathroom bin with a half full brown glass bottle held out above it, pausing, looking down at the bin. Tiled floor, white tile wall, overhead light.
motion: he lowers the bottle a little toward the bin, stops, and lifts it back up again
causality: the bottle stays closed in his hand the whole time and never goes into the bin

change: Close view of the man squeezing a squat cleaner bottle with an angled neck under the rim of a toilet, thick blue gel laying down in a line on the porcelain. His other hand holds the seat up. Even indoor light, no text
motion: he moves the angled neck along under the rim and the line of gel gets longer behind it
causality: gel appears only under the neck as it passes and the line never grows ahead of it

change: The man is crouched at a toilet looking down into the bowl at a grey brown band that is clearly back, his jaw set and his mouth flat, one hand loose on the rim. Small bathroom, tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he breathes out, drops his head slightly and keeps looking at the band

change: Close view of the man's hands writing with a pen on a small paper pad resting on a closed white toilet tank lid, a toolbag strap visible at the edge of the frame. Even indoor light, no text
motion: the pen moves along one line of the pad and he steadies the pad with his other thumb
causality: ink appears only along the path the pen tip has already travelled

change: The man is crouched low beside a toilet with his arm reaching blind behind the base, his cheek almost against the tank and his eyes looking off to the side while he feels for something. Tiled floor, white tile wall.
motion: he pushes his arm a little further behind the toilet and turns his head as he feels around

change: Close view down into an open toilet tank as water rises inside it, the float on the fill valve lifting with the surface, the walls wet. Even indoor light from above.
motion: the water level rises and the float rides up with it
causality: the float rises only as much as the water underneath it does

change: Close view down into a white toilet bowl mid flush, the water swirling hard around the sides and dropping away. Even indoor light from above.
motion: the swirling water drops down and away and clean water starts to come back in

change: Close view of the man pouring from a small brown glass bottle into a plain clear measuring cup held in his other hand over a bathroom counter, the liquid rising in the cup. White counter, daylight from the left, no text
motion: he keeps pouring and the level in the cup rises, then he brings the bottle upright
causality: the level in the cup rises only while the bottle is tipped and stops the moment he rights it

change: The man is lowering himself down onto one knee on a folded towel beside a toilet, a small brown glass bottle in one hand and a brush leaning against the base. Tiled floor, white tile, daylight from the left.
motion: he settles his weight down onto the knee on the towel and steadies himself with his free hand on the rim

change: The man is walking slowly along a shelf stacked with rows of plain coloured cleaning bottles, his fingertips trailing across the front of them, looking at the row. Even overhead light, no text
motion: he takes one more slow step along the shelf and his fingertips keep brushing the bottles
causality: the bottles rock very slightly only as his fingers pass and stay standing

change: Close view of the man's hand standing a small brown glass bottle upright on a closed white toilet tank lid and taking his fingers away. White tile behind, daylight from the left.
motion: he sets the bottle down and draws his hand out of the frame, and the bottle stays standing
causality: the bottle stays exactly where he set it once his hand leaves

change: The man is standing beside a clean white toilet talking toward the camera with one hand pointing down at the bowl without looking at it. Small tidy bathroom, white tile, daylight from a window on the left.
motion: he keeps talking and moves the pointing hand a little as he speaks, then lets it fall

change: The man is leaning one shoulder against a bathroom door frame with his arms loosely crossed, talking toward the camera, the clean toilet visible in the room behind him. Daylight from inside the bathroom.
motion: he shifts his shoulder against the door frame and keeps talking, then uncrosses one arm

change: The man is standing over a clean white toilet looking down into the bright empty bowl with a small satisfied nod, one hand resting on the closed tank lid. Small tidy bathroom, daylight from a window on the left.
motion: he nods once at the bowl and takes his hand off the tank lid
